item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "f7d452baf610bee2366aca746ae6bde9ac08af488b14d3749e132b79acef5709",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real square matrix A indexed by a finite type ι, there exist real numbers λ_p and an ι-indexed basis (b_p) of the real vector space ι → ℝ such that A b_p = λ_p b_p for every p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires a real eigenbasis for the one-by-one matrix [coefficient(x)] at each real x. The eigenvalues and basis are existentially quantified separately at each x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For functions a : ℝ → ℝ and F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, every profile u : ℝ → ℝ, point x, and real slope s satisfy: if u has derivative s at x, then y ↦ F(y,u(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "The target denies the existence of a single F satisfying this universal derivative property for the chosen coefficient.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Maps a real number c to the matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates whose sole entry is c.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix tested for a real eigenbasis at x is exactly [coefficient(x)].",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Asserts continuity of real scalar multiplication on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuous scalar action needed by the derivative predicate; it adds no assumption on the coefficient or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both component propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "All four properties must hold for the same coefficient witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContDiff",
      "meaning": "Continuous differentiability to the specified order. At an order WithTop.some n its displayed definition requires a Taylor-series family up to that order; the separate outer-top branch additionally imposes analyticity.",
      "effect_on_target": "The order is WithTop.some of the infinite element of ENat, so the coefficient is C∞ on all of ℝ. The analytic outer-top branch is not selected.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts a nontrivially normed field structure from a densely normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar-field structure for differentiation without adding a quantified hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "ENat",
      "meaning": "Natural numbers with an additional greatest element, infinity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its greatest element specifies differentiability of every finite order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over the indicated type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces the coefficient, the pointwise eigenvalues and eigenbasis, and the flux whose existence is negated.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural-number indices strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has the single index 0, giving a one-dimensional vector space and a one-by-one matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin n as a finite type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the singleton enumeration used for matrix-vector multiplication at dimension one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Projects the strict comparison relation from an LT structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses 0 < coefficient(x) using the real strict order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies dimension one, finite indices, and the finite orders underlying infinite differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real field and norm used to construct the real normed vector spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both domain and codomain of the coefficient use the usual real normed vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Negation of P is the implication P → False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Rules out every flux satisfying the stated derivative property.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type through its numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 0 as real zero and 1 as the natural-number dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All coefficient values, flux arguments and values, profile arguments and values, slopes, eigenvalues, and matrix entries are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed-field structure with the densely normed property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the fixed scalar field for real calculus; it is not an additional condition on any witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict-order structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes positivity ordinary strict real positivity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero element of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the lower comparison value in the positivity condition as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual normed additive structures for real continuous differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "Projects the distinguished greatest element from a Top structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects infinity in ENat as the inner smoothness order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "WithTop.some",
      "meaning": "Embeds an element into a type with an additional top element using Option.some.",
      "effect_on_target": "Embeds ENat infinity into WithTop ENat, keeping it distinct from the newly added outer top.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral zero using a type's zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the numeral in 0 < coefficient(x) denotes real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral as that natural number itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the matrix dimension to exactly one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "instTopENat",
      "meaning": "The greatest element of ENat is its adjoined infinity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Together with WithTop.some, selects the C∞ order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Gives a commutative semiring its algebra structure over itself, with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the ordinary real scalar action appearing in the dependency structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication of an algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "The real self-algebra action is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the designated multiplicative unit while retaining the ring operations and commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker algebraic interface for real matrix arithmetic without changing its operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real semiring operations needed for modules and bases.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Coerces a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows evaluation of a basis at an index to obtain its basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact vector equality A b_p = λ_p b_p.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration containing every element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the index sums in matrix-vector multiplication finite; the target uses a singleton index type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts scalar multiplication to functions pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Multiplication of an eigenvector by an eigenvalue is coordinatewise real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Projects a multiplication operation from an HMul structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative required of the composed flux is the real product coefficient(x) times slope.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects a scalar multiplication operation from an HSMul structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms λ_p b_p in the eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the full neighborhood filter there.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both profile and composed-flux derivatives are ordinary derivatives on ℝ at x, not derivatives restricted to a subset or a one-sided domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix is a real-valued function on two singleton index sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication, with coordinate i equal to the finite sum of M(i,j)v(j) over j.",
      "effect_on_target": "For [coefficient(x)], multiplication sends the sole coordinate v(0) to coefficient(x)v(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed module basis: a linearly independent spanning family, equivalently giving unique finite coordinate representations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvectors must form a basis of Fin 1 → ℝ; the sole basis vector is nonzero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at index i by mapping the coordinate vector with coefficient 1 at i back through the basis representation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vectors used in the eigenvalue equations are the actual basis vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations of a nonunital commutative ring while dropping associativity from the required interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real matrix arithmetic through a weaker structure without changing real multiplication or addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate algebraic interface for matrix multiplication with unchanged real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, multiplication, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the algebraic structure required by Matrix.mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and operations in the structures supporting calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group, norm, and pseudometric from a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real additive and metric interface for normed-space and derivative constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and metric data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker interface for the fixed real normed structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar multiplication and addition for derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space a module structure using pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin 1 → ℝ the real vector space in which the eigenbasis lives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Gives a dependent function space pointwise addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides coordinatewise vector addition for the eigenbasis vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure underlying a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the usual real metric into the topology used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.commRing",
      "meaning": "The commutative-ring structure of the reals with real addition, multiplication, zero, one, negation, and subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the arithmetic in the real vector spaces and matrix equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The inferred additive commutative-group structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real additive group used by calculus and normed structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inferred additive commutative-monoid structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports pointwise vector addition and the real module basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred commutative-semiring structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-algebra and scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The multiplication operation on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes coefficient(x) times slope and scalar products ordinary real products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real commutative-ring operations with the real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible real algebraic and topological structures for the derivative machinery.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its norm and metric, including multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed scalar field underlying smoothness and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance d(x,y) = |x-y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the usual real topology used in the derivative statements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real modules and bases with ordinary arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the designated unit while preserving the seminorm, pseudometric, and commutative-ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate structure for the real additive and topological interfaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Semiring.toModule",
      "meaning": "Regards a semiring as a module over itself, acting by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the real scalar action on ℝ with real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real topology used by HasDerivAt and continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's multiplication as a homogeneous instance of heterogeneous multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the derivative value coefficient(x) times slope to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an existing scalar action as the corresponding heterogeneous scalar-action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves eigenvalue multiplication of basis vectors to the supplied pointwise real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar-action map (r,v) ↦ r • v is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "For real scalars acting on ℝ, this is continuity of multiplication, supplied by D004 rather than assumed of a witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts a normed commutative-ring structure from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm, metric, and ring operations in the analytic dependency chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker interface retaining the real metric and operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric space carried by a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the metric-derived topology used for real scalar-action continuity and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "instSMulOfMul",
      "meaning": "Defines a type's scalar action on itself by its multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures real self-scalar multiplication means the ordinary product of real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "There exists a single coefficient function a : ℝ → ℝ.",
      "For positivity, every x ∈ ℝ is universally quantified.",
      "For the matrix condition, every x ∈ ℝ is universally quantified, followed by existential witnesses λ : Fin 1 → ℝ and b, a Fin 1-indexed real basis of Fin 1 → ℝ; these witnesses may depend on x and a.",
      "Within each eigenbasis condition, every p ∈ Fin 1 is universally quantified.",
      "The negated existential ranges over all functions F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, equivalently functions on ℝ²; a candidate F may depend on a.",
      "Inside the denied flux property, every profile u : ℝ → ℝ and every x,s ∈ ℝ are universally quantified after F is fixed."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no outer hypotheses or free mathematical parameters.",
      "Within the universal flux property, the antecedent is that u has derivative s at x. No differentiability of u away from x is assumed."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The same coefficient a is infinitely continuously differentiable on all of ℝ.",
      "For every real x, a(x) > 0.",
      "For every real x, the one-by-one real matrix A_x = [a(x)] has a real eigenbasis: there exist λ and b as specified such that A_x b_p = λ_p b_p for every p ∈ Fin 1.",
      "There is no function F : ℝ² → ℝ such that, for every u : ℝ → ℝ and every x,s ∈ ℝ, u having derivative s at x implies that y ↦ F(y,u(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Fin 1 is the singleton index set {0}; its real function space is one-dimensional.",
      "For i,j ∈ Fin 1, A_x(i,j) = a(x). Consequently (A_x v)(0) = a(x)v(0).",
      "A real eigenbasis means a basis of the entire real vector space consisting of eigenvectors with real eigenvalues; neither normalization nor orthogonality is required.",
      "The smoothness index is the embedded infinity of ENat in WithTop ENat, expressing C∞ smoothness rather than the separate analytic order.",
      "A real function g has derivative t at x when its ordinary real difference quotient tends to t as the increment tends to zero.",
      "The flux property is the identity (d/dy)F(y,u(y)) evaluated at y=x equals a(x)u′(x), required whenever the derivative of u at x exists."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "There exists an infinitely continuously differentiable function a : ℝ → ℝ that is strictly positive at every real point and for which each matrix [a(x)] admits a basis of real eigenvectors, but for which no single function F : ℝ² → ℝ has the following property: for every real-valued profile u on ℝ, every real point x, and every real slope s, if u has derivative s at x, then the function y ↦ F(y,u(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The matrix dimension is fixed to one. The statement does not quantify over arbitrary dimensions or general matrix-valued coefficient fields.",
    "The eigenbasis condition is automatic for every one-by-one real matrix: the standard basis works with eigenvalue a(x). It adds no restriction beyond the scalar setting.",
    "The eigenbasis witnesses are pointwise existential. No continuity, smoothness, normalization, or uniform bound on a chosen eigenbasis is encoded.",
    "Strict positivity is pointwise; no uniform positive lower bound, upper bound, or growth condition on a is asserted.",
    "All functions have full real domains. The statement does not concern only a selected interval, a neighborhood, or a restricted set of states.",
    "A profile is required to be differentiable only at the point under consideration. For profiles without the specified derivative the implication imposes no condition, but affine profiles realize every value and slope at every point, so the universal property is not vacuous.",
    "The denied flux is an arbitrary function on ℝ². No separate continuity or differentiability hypothesis on F is imposed; existence of the specified derivatives along all differentiable profiles is part of the denied property itself.",
    "The same flux must work for all profiles and points. The statement does not merely deny a flux chosen separately for each profile.",
    "The identity differentiates both arguments through y ↦ F(y,u(y)); it is not merely an assertion about the derivative of F with respect to its second argument.",
    "C∞ smoothness does not assert real analyticity.",
    "No explicit formula for a or explicit nonconstancy condition is included. Nonexistence of the flux is a separate conjunct for the existentially chosen a.",
    "No evolution equation, time variable, solution class, boundary condition, weak formulation, or integral conservation identity is encoded."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
